```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. PACKAGES AND SETTINGS
# ============================================================

# Install if necessary
# install.packages("ranger")
# install.packages("dplyr")
# install.packages("ggplot2")

library(ranger)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Reproducibility
set.seed(6769)

# Keep identical to the previous LOOCV experiment
N_TREES <- 1000
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2. TOURNAMENT DATASETS
# ============================================================

euro_data <- list(
  "2004" = euro_2004,
  "2008" = euro_2008,
  "2012" = euro_2012,
  "2016" = euro_2016,
  "2020" = euro_2020,
  "2024" = euro_2024
)

# Combine all tournaments
EuroAll <- bind_rows(euro_data, .id = "Tournament")

# Ensure chronological ordering
EuroAll$Tournament <- factor(
  EuroAll$Tournament,
  levels = names(euro_data),
  ordered = TRUE
)

# Inspect dataset
dim(EuroAll)
table(EuroAll$Tournament)

# Check observations per tournament
data.frame(
  Tournament = names(euro_data),
  Observations = sapply(euro_data, nrow)
)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 3. RESPONSE AND PREDICTORS
# ============================================================

target <- "Goals"

predictors <- c(
  "GroupStage",
  "GDP",
  "MarketValue",
  "FifaRank",
  "UefaPoints",
  "CLPlayers"
)

required_columns <- c(target, predictors)

# Define model formula
rf_formula <- as.formula(
  paste(
    target,
    "~",
    paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")
  )
)

# Check required columns
stopifnot(
  all(required_columns %in% names(EuroAll))
)

# Check missing values
colSums(is.na(EuroAll[, required_columns]))

# Check variable types
str(EuroAll[, required_columns])
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 4. EVALUATION METRICS
# ============================================================

calculate_metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {

  mae <- mean(abs(actual - predicted))

  rmse <- sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))

  return(
    data.frame(
      MAE = mae,
      RMSE = rmse
    )
  )
}
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5. CHRONOLOGICAL CROSS-VALIDATION FOLDS
# ============================================================

fold_years <- names(euro_data)[-1]

cv_folds <- lapply(seq_along(fold_years), function(i) {

  test_year <- fold_years[i]

  # All tournaments before the validation tournament
  train_years <- names(euro_data)[1:i]

  train_data <- EuroAll %>%
    filter(as.character(Tournament) %in% train_years)

  validation_data <- EuroAll %>%
    filter(as.character(Tournament) == test_year)

  list(
    train = train_data,
    validation = validation_data,
    train_years = train_years,
    year = test_year
  )
})

names(cv_folds) <- fold_years

# Inspect the folds
fold_sizes <- data.frame(
  Validation_Tournament = fold_years,

  Training_Tournaments = sapply(
    cv_folds,
    function(x) paste(x$train_years, collapse = ", ")
  ),

  Training_Observations = sapply(
    cv_folds,
    function(x) nrow(x$train)
  ),

  Validation_Observations = sapply(
    cv_folds,
    function(x) nrow(x$validation)
  )
)

print(fold_sizes, row.names = FALSE)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 6. HYPERPARAMETER GRID
# ============================================================

rf_grid <- expand.grid(

  mtry = 1:length(predictors),

  min.node.size = c(3, 5, 10, 15),

  sample.fraction = c(0.7, 0.85, 1.0)

)

# Number of combinations
nrow(rf_grid)

# Inspect grid
head(rf_grid)

# Confirm settings
summary(rf_grid)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 7. CHRONOLOGICAL RANDOM FOREST CROSS-VALIDATION
# ============================================================

# Store results for every hyperparameter combination
cv_results <- vector("list", nrow(rf_grid))

# Also retain individual fold results
all_fold_results <- vector("list", nrow(rf_grid))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(rf_grid))) {

  # Current hyperparameter combination
  params <- rf_grid[i, ]

  # Store metrics for each chronological fold
  fold_results <- vector("list", length(cv_folds))

  for (j in seq_along(cv_folds)) {

    # Training and validation data
    train_data <- cv_folds[[j]]$train
    validation_data <- cv_folds[[j]]$validation

    # Fit Random Forest
    rf_model <- ranger(
      formula = rf_formula,
      data = train_data[, required_columns],
      num.trees = N_TREES,
      mtry = params$mtry,
      min.node.size = params$min.node.size,
      sample.fraction = params$sample.fraction,
      importance = "none",
      seed = 6769 + i * 10 + j
    )

    # Predict on the next tournament
    predictions <- predict(
      rf_model,
      data = validation_data[, predictors]
    )$predictions

    # Calculate metrics
    metrics <- calculate_metrics(
      validation_data$Goals,
      predictions
    )

    fold_results[[j]] <- data.frame(
      Tournament = cv_folds[[j]]$year,
      MAE = metrics$MAE,
      RMSE = metrics$RMSE
    )
  }

  # Combine fold results for this parameter combination
  fold_results_df <- bind_rows(fold_results)

  # Save individual fold results
  all_fold_results[[i]] <- cbind(
    rf_grid[i, ],
    fold_results_df
  )

  # Calculate average performance across tournaments
  cv_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    mtry = params$mtry,
    min.node.size = params$min.node.size,
    sample.fraction = params$sample.fraction,
    Mean_MAE = mean(fold_results_df$MAE),
    Mean_RMSE = mean(fold_results_df$RMSE),
    SD_MAE = sd(fold_results_df$MAE)
  )

  # Progress indicator
  if (i %% 10 == 0 || i == nrow(rf_grid)) {
    cat(
      "Completed",
      i,
      "of",
      nrow(rf_grid),
      "combinations\n"
    )
  }
}

# Combine all results
cv_results <- bind_rows(cv_results)

# Sort by mean cross-validation MAE
cv_results <- cv_results %>%
  arrange(Mean_MAE)

# Combine individual fold results
fold_results_all <- bind_rows(all_fold_results)

# Display best 10 combinations
head(cv_results, 10)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 8. INSPECT CROSS-VALIDATION RESULTS
# ============================================================

# Best 10 combinations
cv_results %>%
  select(
    mtry,
    min.node.size,
    sample.fraction,
    Mean_MAE,
    Mean_RMSE,
    SD_MAE
  ) %>%
  head(10)

# Best combination based on mean MAE
best_params <- cv_results[1, ]

cat("\nBest hyperparameters:\n")
print(best_params)

# Individual fold performance for the best combination
best_fold_results <- fold_results_all %>%
  filter(
    mtry == best_params$mtry,
    min.node.size == best_params$min.node.size,
    sample.fraction == best_params$sample.fraction
  )

cat("\nPerformance by validation tournament:\n")
print(best_fold_results)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 9. HYPERPARAMETER TUNING PLOT
# ============================================================

ggplot(
  cv_results,
  aes(
    x = factor(mtry),
    y = Mean_MAE,
    color = factor(min.node.size),
    shape = factor(sample.fraction)
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest Hyperparameter Tuning",
    subtitle = "Chronological expanding-window cross-validation",
    x = "Number of predictors considered at each split (mtry)",
    y = "Mean cross-validation MAE",
    color = "Minimum node size",
    shape = "Sample fraction"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 9B. BEST MODEL: PERFORMANCE BY TOURNAMENT
# ============================================================

ggplot(
  best_fold_results,
  aes(x = Tournament, y = MAE, group = 1)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Best Random Forest: Chronological Validation",
    subtitle = "MAE for each held-out tournament",
    x = "Validation tournament",
    y = "MAE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 10. FINAL RANDOM FOREST MODEL
# ============================================================

# Extract best hyperparameters
best_mtry <- best_params$mtry

best_min_node_size <- best_params$min.node.size

best_sample_fraction <- best_params$sample.fraction

# Fit final model using all tournaments
set.seed(6769)

rf_final <- ranger(
  formula = rf_formula,
  data = EuroAll[, required_columns],
  num.trees = N_TREES,
  mtry = best_mtry,
  min.node.size = best_min_node_size,
  sample.fraction = best_sample_fraction,
  importance = "permutation",
  seed = 6769
)

# Display final model
print(rf_final)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 11. OUT-OF-BAG PERFORMANCE
# ============================================================

# OOB mean squared error
oob_mse <- rf_final$prediction.error

# OOB RMSE
oob_rmse <- sqrt(oob_mse)

# OOB R-squared
oob_r_squared <- rf_final$r.squared

oob_results <- data.frame(
  OOB_MSE = oob_mse,
  OOB_RMSE = oob_rmse,
  OOB_R_squared = oob_r_squared
)

print(oob_results)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 12. VARIABLE IMPORTANCE
# ============================================================

importance <- sort(
  rf_final$variable.importance,
  decreasing = TRUE
)

# Display importance scores
print(importance)

# Plot variable importance
par(mar = c(8, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)

barplot(
  importance,
  las = 2,
  col = "steelblue",
  main = "Random Forest: Variable Importance",
  ylab = "Permutation importance",
  cex.names = 0.85
)
```
